name: Aizel Network
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The official X account of the blockchain AI project Aizel Network was hacked at noon on January 11 and is currently in the process of being recovered. The official reminder to users is to be cautious of the content posted by this account, do not trust any token information, and avoid clicking on any suspicious links or participating in any suspicious activities.
